title: reject-manifest-only-final-proof
summary: Added findFinalProofViolations() pure helper plus validateFinalGates() scan of plan_final/final-gates/*.json, exposed three rejection categories (pending-fixture, manifest-only, human-attestation-alone), and added five focused tests covering each rejection plus two acceptance controls (paired oracle evidence and live-capture replacement). validatePlan() now calls validateFinalGates() after validateAcceptanceTests().
